# Download stats

One txt file per month. Each line is: platform, then the number of downloads in one batch, separated by a space.
Platform names match exactly: linux-arm is a different platform from linux.

Using the monthly files in stats, how many downloads were there in total for the linux platform? stats/README.md describes the format.
